categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the Tests label and adds BIP352 scanning utilities directly to test/functional/test_framework/ for use across functional tests.
categories.rationale: Adds test framework capabilities that unblock independent functional testing for upcoming silent payments features like sending. As described by the author, this was 'Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently' so functional tests can check silent payment outputs without relying on bitcoind node logic.
